title: SWAP core invariant audit for standard WOFOST evolution readiness

3_explicit_data_separation.evidence: parameters, committed crop state, event forcing, accepted cross-process aggregates, rates/workspace, results and diagnostics are explicitly separate

4_compact_persistent_state.evidence: common continuation is minimal; LAI/WLV/LASUM/ILV are derived; vernalization and adaptive root state are option-dependent; potential shadow is excluded

5_scratch_per_worker.evidence: dtsum, dvr, daylp, vernrate and WOFOST_rates are event/worker-local rather than permanent per-column state

6_scalable_memory_layout.evidence: SoA/pools/batches and compact active cohort storage remain permitted; no object-per-column internal layout is required

7_transactional_time_steps.evidence: complete enabled crop continuation is candidate-only; prepare/aggregate/finalize phases do not create a second commit authority; F-KT owns publication and rollback

8_cheap_recalculation_and_warm_start.evidence: same crop checkpoint plus forcing and frozen accepted aggregates must replay identically; numerical warm starts cannot replace the committed physical origin

9_generic_time.evidence: the kernel remains [t0,t1]-generic while standard WOFOST is admitted first as its own explicit one-day physical process cadence; arbitrary dt substitution is forbidden

10_flexible_coupling_windows.evidence: crop windows are runtime events and accepted aggregates may span smaller kernel/coupling intervals; no MODFLOW or midnight boundary is encoded in crop state
10_flexible_coupling_windows.hold: production runtime window-accumulator persistence across smaller commits is not implemented by F-WOF25

11_coupling_core_functionality.evidence: crop evolution consumes accepted process results and remains under the same transaction authority, so rollback/coupling composition is not bypassed

13_absolute_mass_conservation.evidence: IQROT/IPTRA/IALPWET are read-only accepted aggregates for crop physics; root-water mass ownership remains exactly-once under F-KT/F-MR

16_MultiSWAP_primary_use_case.evidence: execution classes can group active standard WOFOST, IDSL2, root topology and oxygen-context requirements while sharing immutable parameter sets

21_reuse_SWAP_physics.evidence: the contracts preserve standard WOFOST assimilation, phenology, allocation, cohort and root semantics rather than replacing them with a reduced model

23_physics_solver_policy_separation.evidence: IDSL/SWRD/SWRDC/oxygen are physical options; numerical reference/balanced/throughput policies do not alter them

25_reference_mode_available.evidence: B1.10 one-day cadence remains the reference oracle
25_reference_mode_available.hold: exact post-vernalised VERN diagnostic reproduction requires an explicit compatibility or expected-difference decision because legacy stale vernrate is not physical continuation state

26_runtime_diagnostics.evidence: the event signature returns diagnostics and lineage/aggregate provenance is explicit
26_runtime_diagnostics.hold: production diagnostic fields are deferred to the structural candidate

27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us.evidence: IDSL2, adaptive root state, potential shadow and nutrient/grass state are not universally allocated

28_runtime_coupler_system_composition.evidence: crop scheduling, crop-window aggregation and calendar translation are runtime/provider responsibilities outside the crop kernel

29_no_hidden_dependencies.evidence: no hidden daynr/t1900/calendar globals, .swp parsing, midnight assumption, MODFLOW dependency or Richards-substep-equals-crop-day assumption is admitted

30_every_architecture_change_audited.evidence: F-WOF25 explicitly audits state, API/event cadence, transactions, MultiSWAP scaling and cross-process aggregation before production implementation
